column1: # HISTORICAL: record of the one-off move from the author's private tree to this repository. No script
# or CI uses it; kept so the stage can be followed. Names in it are the names of that time.
# Pinned code changes made on purpose before stage E2a (E0: captures and fixture paths; E1: project
# identity in project.json / include/project_identity.h, CXX in run_host_tests.sh) and in stage E2b
# (English environment, file and identifier names from tools/rename_map.tsv, UTF-8 test data as escapes).
# For stage E3 the base is the tree after E2, so these pins are not needed there.
# Format: path TAB mode (code|strings) TAB sha256 of the reduced stream of the new file TAB reason.
# A pinned file passes only while its reduced stream keeps exactly this hash (tools/check_comment_only.py).
